items.html: The third interpretation is that the ten Sefirot of Katnut, which are entirely Elokim, are divided into two aspects, which are pregnancy and nursing. For the three lower ones are pregnancy, and the six upper ones together are called nursing. And afterward, all the ten Sefirot of Gadlut, which are Havayot, are called the second pregnancy. And behold, the three above-mentioned aspects, namely the pregnancy and nursing of Katnut and the pregnancy of Gadlut — all this is called externality, because they are from the NHY of Tevuna and Yeshsut. And afterward, these same three aspects — two of Katnut and one of Gadlut — because they are from the NHY of the supernal Aba and Ima, are called internality.
